summary: First post-MVP test of Travelo — full backend + frontend + integration coverage. Ran 24 pytest cases against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and drove the UI with Playwright (unauth + cookie-injected authed flows). All backend endpoints (health, destinations, hotels, cars, curated places, auth, bookings, demo payments, logout) and all critical UI flows (landing, hotels list/detail, cars list/detail, destinations index/detail with nearby, unauth Reserve→auth.emergentagent.com redirect, cookie-authed /my-bookings, and full demo-mode Reserve→Checkout→Pay→Success flow) passed. Razorpay demo_mode + Google Places curated fallback both behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cookie is set with sameSite='none' + secure=true which works over HTTPS preview but requires HTTPS in production too — fine, just document.

server.py mixes inventory constants, models, routes in one file (~470 lines) — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting inventory/curated data into a data module and routers into feature modules if the app grows.
GET /api/bookings/{booking_id} route is declared AFTER GET /api/bookings/mine which is correct; ordering-safe as 'mine' is a literal path. No issue currently but flagging for awareness.
/api/payments/verify happily accepts any signature when RZP_IS_LIVE=False. Fine for demo mode as designed, but ensure keys are swapped before going live so HMAC path activates.
/api/places/nearby generic fallback (no destination) hardcodes goa data — acceptable for demo but consider returning empty or a real distance-based response when Maps is live and lat/lng miss.
No rate limiting on /api/bookings — a real deployment should throttle authenticated booking creation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: landing, hotels list/filter/detail, cars list/detail, destinations index/detail w/ curated places, unauth reserve redirect, authed /my-bookings, full demo checkout success)

test_credentials: No credentials required. For authed flows, tests seed a Mongo user + session_token per /app/auth_testing.md (used both as Bearer header for backend and as session_token cookie for browser). All TEST_ prefixed data is cleaned up after tests.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py session-scoped fixture creates a fresh Mongo user + user_sessions doc and deletes them (and any associated bookings) on teardown. Frontend testing used a dedicated seeded session (test-user-fe-*) which was manually cleaned via mongosh after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_travelo_backend.py — reuse it. RAZORPAY_KEY_ID starts with 'rzp_test_placeholder_key' and GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY starts with 'placeholder' so demo/curated modes are active. Auth flow expects a session_token cookie (httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None) OR Authorization: Bearer header. To drive the browser under an authed session, seed a Mongo user+session_token per /app/auth_testing.md, then inject the cookie via page.context.add_cookies with the exact backend/frontend hostname. Full demo-mode checkout works end-to-end (booking POST returns order_demo_* + demo_mode=true, then /payments/verify skips HMAC and marks paid).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failures encountered. Initial 'destinations page not found' error in the first Playwright run was on my side (wrong data-testid: page uses 'destinations-index-page' not 'destinations-page'); corrected on re-run.
